etsy.title: Relax Room Sign, Unwind Zone Decompression Space Poster, Calm Room Wall Art, Therapy Office Decor
etsy.description:
A soft relax room sign marking an Unwind Zone for decompression spaces, relaxation corners, and no-pressure retreat rooms.

WHAT YOU'LL GET
• A physical poster print, shipped directly to you
• Available in 8×10 in or 11×17 in
• Printed on premium matte paper at 300 DPI

HOW TO USE
Frame and hang near a reading chair, relaxation corner, or retreat space at home, school, or a therapy office.

This listing is a physical poster print, not a substitute for professional medical, therapy, or educational advice. Thank you for supporting a small, neurodivergent-run shop!

competitorNotes: 'Decompression' signs on Etsy are mostly novelty dive/bathroom 'decompression chamber' jokes, so the phrase alone attracts the wrong buyer.
Calm and quiet room signs use 'Calm Corner', 'Quiet Corner', 'Calm Room' or 'Relax Room' wording.
Most shared-project results (sensory room, calm corner, neurodiversity decor) are digital printables; stating 'physical poster print' separates this listing.
Amazon relax decor is spa-style word signs and zen canvases; few are framed as a no-pressure decompression space for neurodivergent people.

research.notes: Chose 'relax room sign' (indexed Etsy phrase) over 'decompression room' (novelty-dominated) and over calm corner phrases, which regulation-station targets. Listing pages were not reachable from this environment (WebFetch blocked); evidence is from search results only. No priceRange: snippets mixed digital downloads with physical signs and did not separate physical poster prices.
